{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build-and-test
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-ubuntu:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
         transform: [fftw, kiss_fft]
         cc: [gcc, clang]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libmagickwand-7.q16-dev libfftw3-dev libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev curl gawk libcmocka-dev
      - name: Configure resdet with FFTW
        if: matrix.transform == 'fftw'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Configure resdet with KISSFFT
        if: matrix.transform == 'kiss_fft'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --disable-fftw
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
            CFLAGS: -Wno-invalid-feature-combination
      - name: Build resdet
        run: make
      - name: Install resdet
        run: sudo make install install-lib
      - name: Install bash_unit
        run: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bash-unit/bash_unit/master/install.sh | bash
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('test/bindings/python/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Set up python binding tests
        run: make .testvenv
      - name: Run tests
        run: make check
      - name: Run resdet
        run: resdet -v0 test/files/blue_marble_2012_resized.pfm
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
         transform: [fftw, kiss_fft]
         cc: [gcc-15, clang]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew update
          brew install fftw imagemagick ffmpeg gawk cmocka bash_unit #libpng and libjpeg are already installed
      - name: Configure resdet with FFTW
        if: matrix.transform == 'fftw'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Configure resdet with KISSFFT
        if: matrix.transform == 'kiss_fft'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --disable-fftw
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Build resdet
        run: make
      - name: Install resdet
        run: |
          sudo mkdir /usr/local/include /usr/local/lib
          sudo make install install-lib
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('test/bindings/python/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Set up python binding tests
        run: make .testvenv
      - name: Run tests
        run: make check
      - name: Run resdet
        run: resdet -v0 test/files/blue_marble_2012_resized.pfm
  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
         transform: [fftw, kiss_fft]
         cc: [gcc, clang]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: msys2 {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: UCRT64
          update: true
          install: mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-clang pkg-config make curl mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libpng mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libjpeg-turbo mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-imagemagick mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-ffmpeg gawk mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-cmocka mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-pip mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-numpy mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-pillow mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-pytest
      - name: Configure resdet with FFTW
        if: matrix.transform == 'fftw'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --prefix=/ucrt64 --libprefix=/ucrt64/bin
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Configure resdet with KISSFFT
        if: matrix.transform == 'kiss_fft'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --prefix=/ucrt64 --libprefix=/ucrt64/bin --disable-fftw
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Build resdet
        run: make
      - name: Install resdet
        run: make install install-lib
      - name: Install bash_unit
        run: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bash-unit/bash_unit/master/install.sh | bash
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('test/bindings/python/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Set up python binding tests
        run: |
          mkdir -p .testvenv/bin
          touch .testvenv/bin/activate # python dependencies were installed with pacman
      - name: Run tests
        run: make check
      - name: Run resdet
        run: ./resdet.exe -v0 test/files/blue_marble_2012_resized.pfm
  build-and-test-js-bindings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew update
          brew install emscripten
      - name: Configure resdet
        run: ./configure --cc=emcc --ar=emar --disable-everything --omit-pgm-reader --omit-pfm-reader --omit-y4m-reader
      - name: Build resdet.mjs
        run: make resdet.mjs
      - name: Run tests
        run: make check_emscripten_bindings",
  "rationale": "The workflow reinstalls dependencies on every run with no cache. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) is supported: repeated dependency fetching is measurable across all jobs, a pinned dependency manifest exists (test/bindings/python/requirements.txt), and no equivalent cache exists in the workflow. Adding actions/cache@v4 for pip downloads, keyed on runner.os plus the requirements file hash, mirrors the evidenced example and preserves every build/configure/install/test step and all matrix coverage. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or publishing/deployment operations are added, and no new network access beyond the standard cache action is introduced. The JS bindings job already caches npm via setup-node, so it is left unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
